candidates.name: Search the index map
verified_facts: The index map is used to identify title numbers for registered or registering land when ordinary register search is insufficient.
The search may use an address, a plan or an Ordnance Survey map reference to identify the area.
semantic_limits: Index-map title discovery does not certify the exact legal boundary or provide a terrain elevation observation.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry public guidance
verified_facts: HM Land Registry public guidance separates title-register, title-plan and property-boundary information into distinct guidance routes.
Boundary guidance is presented as interpretation of registered information rather than physical elevation surveying.
semantic_limits: A public-guidance navigation page supplies procedural context only and cannot be used as numeric height or survey-accuracy evidence.
